cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor all" "ip link set d0 down; ip link set d0 up; ip addr add 192.0.2.1/24 dev d0; ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 dev d0; ip neigh replace 192.0.2.254 lladdr 02:00:00:00:00:01 dev d0; echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/d0/forwarding" "d0: <" "192.0.2.1/24" "198.51.100.0/24 dev d0" "192.0.2.254 dev d0 lladdr" "inet d0 forwarding on"
desc: positive: one ip monitor all over a link, an address, a route, a neigh and a netconf, the mixed time sequence
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.default.forwarding=1 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip link add d0 type dummy && ip link set d0 addrgenmode none && ip link set d0 up
